$comment: Bounded, committed waiver for the Production E2E gate.
RULES ENFORCED BY scripts/e2e-gate.mjs (not by convention):
1. A waived test still RUNS. Nothing is skipped or deleted.
2. Past `expires`, the gate FAILS on the waiver itself. It cannot rot.
3. A waived test that starts PASSING fails the gate until it is removed
— unless marked `unstable`, which means it is waived because it flaps.
4. Any failure NOT listed here fails the gate normally.
5. Window capped at 30 days; policy path hard-coded in the script.
6. Entries are keyed on file + test title, never on line numbers.
Baseline: Production E2E had never been green — 0 successes in 405 runs since
2026-05-17. main @ b2ee7c88 = 57 failed / 177 passed. Now 7 failed / 207 passed.
THE FLAKINESS IS SOLVED AT THE ROOT. /auth/register is capped at 10/min/IP;
every test registers a throwaway user and CI retries multiplied that, so
whichever tests landed in a saturated window died — a DIFFERENT test on every
run. AUTH_REGISTER_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=2000 in the E2E workflows removed it: the
whole mobile-device-matrix cluster and both one-off flakes are gone from this
list, and the run went from 3 flaky to 1.
What remains needs a product answer, not a test edit.

waived.test: tests/e2e/dashboard.spec.ts › opens preserved Bolt IDE route for a project
waived.reason: A computed `position` reads '' instead of 'relative' — the measured element is missing, not mis-styled. Needs the current IDE layout contract to rewrite against.

waived.test: tests/e2e/dashboard.spec.ts › authenticated user area applies the global platform design system
waived.reason: Forcing light via the ecode_theme cookie is the WRONG lever for IDE surfaces: BaseChat calls applyProjectThemePreference() once the settings payload lands and re-applies the per-account/project theme over the document. The cookie only wins when that preference is 'system'. The test needs to set the account preference through the API instead — needs the settings contract.

waived.test: tests/e2e/dashboard.spec.ts › IDE light theme tabs use visible tokenized surfaces
waived.reason: Same lever problem: data-theme is light right after forceLightTheme(), then flips back to dark when the IDE re-applies the account preference. Verified live that the light theme itself works (--vc-ide-bg-app #f6f8fb holds for 30s outside the IDE settings path).

waived.test: tests/e2e/dashboard.spec.ts › all IDE service panels keep light theme containers readable
waived.reason: Same lever problem, PLUS a candidate real bug worth a ticket: with the theme forced, `database` and `deployments` still report dark containers while other panels comply. Needs a product look once the theme lever is right.

waived.test: tests/e2e/dashboard.spec.ts › IDE applies section 12 UI detail styles
waived.reason: NEW, sharper failure — the add-tab palette now opens (the retried click fixed that), so this is a genuine token divergence: a radius reads 6px where the spec says 4px. Needs design arbitration, not a test edit.

waived.test: tests/e2e/dashboard.spec.ts › IDE project services open as in-place panels instead of legacy project pages
waived.reason: Still times out on a click after 120s once the palette is open. The palette mounting is fixed; what follows it is not yet diagnosed.

waived.test: tests/e2e/dashboard.spec.ts › command palette entries navigate to real product routes
waived.reason: role='option' locator is now correct and this passes in some runs. Kept one cycle to confirm.
